scope: Phase 8 public exports, verification registry, agent manifest and tests

findings.summary: Pilot artifacts accepted terminal status without proving required result channels.
External comparison metadata could pass without recomputed numerical errors.
Q5 did not require a completed review and complete M0-M10 historical evidence.
Target-size memory preflight used the medium kernel size instead of the fixed target fixture.
Candidate pilot reproducibility was reported as independent NL-PILOT qualification PASS.
